semantic_summary:
* GSetBigFont: create (once) the "Gaia8x14" big font from fontres.fon,
 * broadcast WM_FONTCHANGE, then measure it: GetDC(rootWnd), select the
 * font (saving the previous one), GetTextMetrics into a local buffer,
 * derive an average width byte and a signed rounded half-height byte
 * into private scratch, restore/select back and release the DC.  If a
 * clip DC exists, its previously-selected font (savedFont, reused across
 * calls) is selected there instead once; either way the font's average
 * width/height bytes are copied to the public fontWidth/fontHeight.
